review: The fixed inventory SHA, exact two CPU namespaces and safe relative members prevent expanding this retention into model/source input copying. The Docker executable duplicate is enumerated and excluded from the archive while remaining part of the exact source namespace check.

Original source and metadata handles use O_NOFOLLOW, single-link regular-file checks, full seven-field epoch comparisons, held ancestor identities and final source namespace checks. The archive records each original URI and epoch rather than rebinding a copied path as original authority.

Streaming source reads and archive replay use one-MiB chunks. Each source is below 64 MiB; the fixed 165,944,632-byte total and small fixed 128-row manifest fit the 256-MiB archive bound. Reopened ZIP membership, CRC and decompressed size/SHA are all checked, followed by physical package hashing.

The v2 write fix permits bounded exclusive failure persistence after the original work clock expires. The final check remains after receipt persistence, original metadata/directory FD retirement and stdout flush; late completion writes a sticky companion and returns nonzero. The original 120-second timeout plus 10-second kill reserve must remain in the actual launch recipe.

The GPU terminal is supplied by exact physical SHA/size, held and rechecked. Its original numeric PID/group absence is checked before retention. Authentic CPU/GPU UID, boot, startticks, terminal disposition, full95 FD release and process closure remain the separate already-closed root launch prerequisites; this packer does not independently reconstruct those identity proofs.

A retained ZIP and complete retention receipt grant neither hardware nor benchmark acceptance. Failed or partial archives remain failed; original ext4 outputs and historical authority paths are preserved.
required_original_launch_conditions: Root supplies the authentic closed original GPU terminal SHA and size only after its audited process/FD closure and the original CPU closure. No active-output retention.

Root launches the exact reviewed v2 once through the original 120+10 envelope with fresh exclusive capture and output names. Any forced timeout, close error, late companion, nonzero exit or incomplete replay remains failed retention.
Any subsequent report must cite actual retained originals and archive descriptors. It must not infer original model/container acceptance from this copy operation.

scope_limits.reviewer_reads: Only the five small prepared source/metadata files and their ASTs; no original 165.9-MB raw output stream was read or hashed.
scope_limits.reviewer_execution: One inline pinned-CPython metadata/AST/hash inspection, without importing the packer. The inspection has tool output, not a separately fabricated physical dispatch witness.
